svg.text: parallelogram-p2-132-usb6 — Phase 4 Mechanical & Floorplan Brief (25.0 x 70.0 mm, R=1.0 mm fillets, 4L)
Parent: p2-132-usb (J1 unchanged at (-1.24,+26.82) rot 162.26°). Added West-edge EVQP7J01P SW5 (USER_C) & SW6 (USER_D).
Back Side (B.Cu, top-down X-ray, +X East / -X West)
Front Side (F.Cu: 132x XL-1615RGBC + Q2, 0 PTH, 2x J1 NPTH)
Edge Selection Proof: East edge (x=+12.50, straight y in [-26.27,+33.63], R=1.00 mm fillets) South end is blocked by Q1/U8/R8 [y=+6.27..+14.62], BT1 [y=+15.32..+24.78], SW4 [y=+24.90..+32.40].
West edge (x=-12.50, straight y in [-33.63,+26.27], R=1.00 mm fillets) fits BOTH peg-less EVQP7J01P switches (1.35 mm h, 0.20 mm travel: x=-12.95 rest -> -12.75 bottom-out):
* SW6 (USER_D -> U3.2 GPIO0): (-10.85,+22.80) rot 90°, 1.794 mm true rotated Crtyd W of J1, 1.120 mm terminal (0.970 mm pad) N of y=+26.270 fillet; R47 (-7.40,+21.00), C72 (-7.40,+19.80).
